name: SOUTHWESTERN CORNER OF GARAG
text: A dimly lit alcove packed with shelving units
overflowing with spare parts and tools. The
floor is stained with oil and grease, evidence
of countless repairs.

name: SOUTHEASTERN CORNER OF GARAG
text: A partially enclosed workspace containing a
welding setup, complete with gas canisters and
a protective shield. Scorch marks stain the
wall behind the equipment.

name: TALL METAL SHELVING UNIT
text: A sturdy metal shelving unit packed with
various tools, parts, and supplies. It looks
like it's been organized and reorganized
countless times over the years.

name: DOORWAY TO CORRIDOR
text: A heavy metal door leads out of the garage,
its surface scarred and dented. A glowing blue
light panel illuminates the area above the
frame.

name: DOORWAY TO CORRIDOR
text: A reinforced metal door stands slightly ajar,
leading to a darker corridor. A glowing yellow
light panel sits above the frame, casting a
warm glow.

name: HEAVY DUTY SHELVING UNIT
text: A sturdy shelving unit packed with various
mechanical components and supplies. You spot a
battery, a small motor, and several
unidentified metal casings.

name: METAL SHELVING UNIT
text: A metal shelving unit crammed with tools,
parts, and miscellaneous supplies. The bottom
shelf is dominated by a tangle of heavy-duty
cables.

name: WORKBENCH WITH DIAGNOSTICS
text: A solid metal workbench equipped with an old,
flickering diagnostic monitor. The surface is
cluttered with tools, a clipboard, and
scattered notes.

name: WELDING EQUIPMENT SETUP
text: A compact welding unit sits next to a pair of
tall gas canisters, one green and one red. The
wall behind it is heavily scorched from
frequent use.

name: HEAVY DUTY CABLES
text: Thick, black cables snake across the floor,
connecting the vehicle on the lift to a power
source or diagnostic equipment. They're worn
and patched in several places.

name: RED TOOL TROLLEY
text: A standard red metal tool trolley, its drawers
likely filled with wrenches and sockets. It's
positioned conveniently near the vehicle lift.

name: OVERHEAD FLUORESCENT LIGHT
text: A long fluorescent light fixture hangs from
the ceiling, casting a warm, yellowish glow
over the workbench below. It buzzes faintly
with electricity.

name: OVERHEAD FLUORESCENT LIGHT
text: A long fluorescent light fixture is suspended
from the ceiling, illuminating the shelving
units and workbench beneath it. The casing is
slightly rusted at the edges.
